rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for a farewell or command to leave.

example.english: That’s it for today’s meeting, bye.
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 hoi1 wui2 dou3 ni1 dou6 baai3 baai3

rows.note: Use this for a neutral farewell instead of the more casual 拜拜.

example.jyutping: wui2 ji5 dou3 ci2 git3 cuk1 zoi3 gin3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a tournament or competition position that advances without an opponent.

example.english: You get a bye this round and advance straight to the next round.
example.traditional: 今場你輪空，直接晉級下一圈。
example.jyutping: gam1 coeng4 nei5 leon4 hung1 zik6 zip3 zeon3 kap1 haa6 jat1 hyun1
